name: Single Women
overview: Scripture affirms the value and dignity of single women as those who fear the Lord and are clothed with strength and honor, rejoicing in the future (Proverbs 31:25,30). While God created woman as a suitable helper for man (Genesis 2:18), in Christ, distinctions such as male or female are transcended, emphasizing unity and equal standing before God (Galatians 3:28). Single women are called to follow God as His dear children (Ephesians 5:1) and to labor faithfully in the gospel, supported by fellow believers (Philippians 4:3). This teaching underscores a Christ-centered identity and purpose beyond marital status.
